lede: Dallas Cowboys carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play), while Indianapolis Colts owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#21 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Indianapolis Colts −4.0 with a fair total of 52.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Indianapolis Colts pass offence vs Dallas Cowboys pass defence, which sits +0.167 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Dallas Cowboys and Indianapolis Colts have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
